# Frozen Moments Photography

> Fine art photography prints and photography services in Victoria, British
> Columbia, Canada. Landscape, wildlife and world images sold as archival
> prints; wedding, portrait, real estate, product and event photography across
> Vancouver Island.

Kirk Buckland has photographed the West Coast for more than 25 years. Every
print is made to order in Victoria — archival luster or metallic paper,
gallery-wrapped canvas, or aluminium — in the size the buyer chooses, with an
optional mat or floating frame. Limited editions are numbered and never
reprinted once the run closes.

## Fine art prints
- [All collections](https://fmphotography.ca/galleries.html): four collections — West Coast Landscapes, Wildlife, World Images, Limited Edition Prints
- [Store](https://fmphotography.ca/store.html): every available photograph, filterable by collection

## Free tools
- [Loupe](https://fmphotography.ca/tools.html): a free browser tool for photographers that checks exposure, focus and framing on any photograph. Nothing is uploaded.
